tool_args.rationale: The seven observations span the open gradient regime and support numerical fitting of the three identifiable coefficients of the recalled sink-gradient law. Fresh confirmation is needed; behavior above the observed gradient range remains uncertain.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed gradients do not identify its threshold or avalanche coefficient, and the specified high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The observed gradient dependence and monotone concave substrate response favor the recalled sink-gradient mechanism.
No observed trajectory dependence motivates its additional cost or establishes that it would identify the high-gradient branch.
